issues.where: PersianPage.tsx DetailRow date cell (all rows, frame 67)
issues.problem: Date/time is 11px and the date is Gregorian digits in Persian numerals (۲۰۲۶/۰۶/۲۲ ۲۲:۰۰); small and visually weak versus the original 14px; Jalali would be more idiomatic.
issues.suggestedFix: Raise to 12-13px; optionally use a Jalali date string.

issues.problem: The select caret is a literal ⌄ glyph appended to the text with no spacing, so it renders as a tiny stray mark touching the label (original has a native select arrow).
issues.suggestedFix: Give the caret its own span with margin and a drawn chevron placed at the left end of the chip.

issues.problem: Description is one line instead of the original two, leaving empty space in the 95px row slot; rows look slightly bottom-empty.
issues.suggestedFix: Lengthen the sample description or vertically adjust padding; cosmetic only.
